about: Four State College restaurants for the demo, enriched from the team's scraped photo set (combined_restaurant_menu_photos.zip, branch dev-david of HelpingYouSellFoodCompile26). Loaded with scripts/import-demo-restaurants.ts. Allergens are demo placeholders; the real merchants must confirm them.
photo_note: item.photo is the resized JPEG (max 1280 px, quality 80) under photo_base_url. The API sets Deal.photo_url only from POST /merchants/{id}/drafts, so the importer sends that photo there and the backend stores its own copy under photos/.

deal_defaults.deal_price_rule: regular price x 0.6, rounded down to a multiple of 25 cents
deal_defaults.kind_rule: surplus when pickup_end is within 2 h of closes_at, else timed (same rule the API uses for manual deals)
